notes: «وَ سَأَلَهُ اَلْحَلَبِيُّ» : the asker is written; the one asked (an Imam) is not named in this text
prev1 (4178) writes a chain ending at صفوان بن يحيى and names its Imam («أَبَا اَلْحَسَنِ») only in its matn, not in the chain, so no Imam is inherited here and the tool supplies the reading
